mapper.sql: SELECT log_id, supplier_id, supplier_name, eval_id, eval_period, quality_score, grade, pass_rate, ppm, push_status, push_time, retry_count, error_msg, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM qms_sqm_push_log
mapper.select: WHERE del_flag = '0' AND push_status = '0' AND retry_count < 3 ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qms_sqm_push_log ( supplier_id, supplier_name, eval_id, eval_period, quality_score, grade, pass_rate, ppm, push_status, push_time, retry_count, error_msg, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{evalId}, #{evalPeriod}, #{qualityScore}, #{grade}, #{passRate}, #{ppm}, #{pushStatus}, #{pushTime}, #{retryCount}, #{errorMsg}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: UPDATE qms_sqm_push_log SET del_flag = '2' WHERE log_id IN #{logId}
